-- name: ListExampleResources :many
-- The example-resource resource owns this file: one query file per table, and every
-- UPDATE below sets updated_at = now().
--
-- Newest first, with an optional case-insensitive name filter. An empty filter
-- matches every row, so one query serves the plain list and the search box
-- instead of two that can drift apart. The id tiebreak makes the order total.
SELECT * FROM example_resources
WHERE org_id = sqlc.arg(tenant)
  AND (sqlc.arg(query)::text = '' OR name ILIKE '%' || sqlc.arg(query) || '%')
ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
LIMIT sqlc.arg(lim) OFFSET sqlc.arg(off);

-- name: CountExampleResources :one
SELECT count(*) FROM example_resources
WHERE org_id = sqlc.arg(tenant)
  AND (sqlc.arg(query)::text = '' OR name ILIKE '%' || sqlc.arg(query) || '%');

-- name: ListAllExampleResources :many
-- The admin read surface: every tenant's rows, same filter and order. A staff
-- surface that showed only the operator's own tenant would not be an admin
-- surface at all.
SELECT * FROM example_resources
WHERE (sqlc.arg(query)::text = '' OR name ILIKE '%' || sqlc.arg(query) || '%')
ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
LIMIT sqlc.arg(lim) OFFSET sqlc.arg(off);

-- name: CountAllExampleResources :one
SELECT count(*) FROM example_resources
WHERE (sqlc.arg(query)::text = '' OR name ILIKE '%' || sqlc.arg(query) || '%');

-- name: GetExampleResourceByID :one
SELECT * FROM example_resources WHERE id = sqlc.arg(id) AND org_id = sqlc.arg(tenant);

-- name: CreateExampleResource :one
INSERT INTO example_resources (org_id, name)
VALUES (sqlc.arg(tenant), sqlc.arg(name))
RETURNING *;

-- name: UpdateExampleResource :one
UPDATE example_resources SET name = sqlc.arg(name), updated_at = now()
WHERE id = sqlc.arg(id) AND org_id = sqlc.arg(tenant)
RETURNING *;

-- name: DeleteExampleResource :execrows
DELETE FROM example_resources WHERE id = sqlc.arg(id) AND org_id = sqlc.arg(tenant);
